Mean and range

Range · Mean · Compare and check

by Hasan

Thursday

🎯 Today’s objective

By the end of this lesson I can...

✓ I can find the range of a set of data, with negatives

✓ I can work out the mean and check it with a reverse calculation

✓ I can compare two sets of data using the mean and range

So you can compare prices, scores and results like a pro!

🏠 Menu

🌡️ UK weather records

Fun fact: the UK record high is 40.3 °C (2022). The record low is −27.2 °C.

What is the range of the UK record temperatures?

🤔 Guess first! Write it down.

Step 1

Highest − lowest

40.3 − (−27.2)

Step 2

− − is +

40.3 + 27.2 = 67.5 °C

67.5 °C 🥶🥵

Answer

Q2

No calculator

[3 marks]

The heights of 6 children are 132 cm, 145 cm, 128 cm, 150 cm, 139 cm and 141 cm. Work out the range. A new child of 152 cm joins the group. What is the new range?

Hint

Answer

Tallest − shortest.

Answer: 22 cm, 24 cm

Calculator

[4 marks]

Hint

Answer

Use the (−) key on the calculator.

Answer: 60 °C; first base, by 4.1 °C

[5 marks]

A café wants mean takings of at least £350 a day. Takings for 6 days: £412, £298, £271, £340, £399, £476. Did the café meet the target? Check your mean.

Hint

Answer

Divide the total by 6. Check: mean × 6.

Answer: Yes, £366

Calculator

[5 marks]

A team needs the more consistent darts player. Ali scored 45, 60, 38, 52, 55. Ben scored 48, 51, 50, 49, 52. Use the mean and range to choose a player.

Hint

Answer

Same mean? Then smaller range wins.

Answer: Ben: same mean 50, range 4 not 22

Answer

Total allowed − first 4.

Answer: 32 minutes, range 11 minutes
